test_title: PYST 63: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the mother of Q’,

P # Q means ‘P is the husband of Q’,

P & Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’ and

P % Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

How is J related to Z if ‘J # S + R & T % Z’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74c9165e9d1057b2d362d255fa83304c30b6412afd8e6dd4eb65323272fa0ac1.png] 

**Given:**

P + Q → P is the mother of Q

P # Q → P is the husband of Q

P & Q → P is the sister of Q

P % Q → P is the father of Q

**Expression:**

J # S + R & T % Z

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef37b0a4d39493f0153a842ec5a7d3474dc1a8b6528275d403fd8b8d0d6ce555.png] 

**Family chain:**

T is the father of Z.

R is the sister of T, so R is Z's aunt.

S is the mother of R and T.

J is the husband of S.

Therefore, J is the father of T.

Since T is the father of Z, J becomes Z's grandfather.

Hence, J is **Father's father** of Z.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
